acceptable.text: Bump the distill prompt version whenever the prompt text changes, so stored results and eval runs can tell output of different prompt generations apart.
acceptable.evidence: WP4 changes the prompt text, and we need stored results and eval runs to tell WP3-only output from WP4 output.

notes: Real gate note on a split plan. The rest approves the factory's defaults about metadata fields and scope rules: nothing a teammate outside the run would act on. The one change (bump the prompt version) is an instruction for this change, but stated as a general rule with its reason it is a standing team convention, so acceptable at most. distill-v7's candidates from this note were rejected as unreviewable.
